metadata.source: 気象庁 地上気象観測平年値 (1991–2020)

derived.landMask: Natural Earth 1:10m land + minor islands (public domain); cells are kept when their centre is on land
derived.method: Inverse-distance weighting (power 2, 70 km cutoff) of the twelve monthly 日最高気温 normals over all 157 surface stations, evaluated on a 0.1° grid. Cells whose curve never reaches the threshold are omitted entirely.
derived.caveat: Doubly interpolated — across space between stations and across time between months — and this is a NORMAL, not an event: it is the shape of an average summer, not a heatwave that happened. It also has NO ELEVATION AWARENESS: mountain cells are interpolated from the valley stations that ring them, so high ground reads hotter than it is. The 70 km cutoff limits how far that error can travel but does not remove it.
